newsitem.title: UK: Scottish Power to cut jobs at Southern Water.
newsitem.headline: Scottish Power to cut jobs at Southern Water.

text.p: Multi utility company Scottish Power Plc is to cut hundreds of jobs from the Southern Water unit it took over earlier this year, the trade union Unison said on Tuesday.
It is thought that most of the redundancies among Southern's 3,900-strong workforce will be voluntary.
Scottish Power declined to comment on the cuts but said it is informing Southern staff about "what our intentions are in terms of developing the business."

The news of the job cuts comes on the eve of Scottish Power's half year results, which will include a contribution from Southern for the first time and are expected to include details of the rationalisation at Southern.
Analysts believe around 40 million stg of cost savings will have been identified by Scottish Power, including the job cuts, disposals and combining services such as billing.
The most likely targets are thought to be a number of Southern's 30 subsidiary companies which are not related to its core water interests.
